source_of_claim: The user-supplied Four Bayes synthesis, the existing Elastica exponentialWeight and split theorem, and the F0 representative maps.
conditions: Finite candidate spaces; IsDistribution means nonnegative real weights summing to one.
A probability interpretation of posterior requires nonnegative prior and likelihood, and strictly positive total evidence. Algebraic division by zero is explicitly proved not to yield a distribution.
Two fixed-likelihood updates commute when each first-step evidence is nonzero; adaptive choices and deletion are separate operations.
Pushforward posterior commutation uses a likelihood of the form L(f(x)); it therefore depends only on the retained observation.
The actual Elastica interval split requires continuous density and C1 candidate angles; choosing a prior and likelihood is an additional finite probabilistic model.
Binary derivative and odds statements require 0<p<1. Exploration support needs a positive floor and positive generator mass on the candidate.
The exact deletion example uses prior (1/2,1/2), beta=log 3 and deletion threshold 1/3; the predictive-forgetting example uses the existing three-state F0 retraction.
excluded: General KL minimization and a complete Legendre-Fenchel duality proof; binary log-partition first and second derivatives are proved.
Likelihood-ratio martingale or Ville inequality, Poisson waiting laws, infinite-horizon discovery guarantees, and general model-family generation.
New executions of historical Four Bayes Monte Carlo or Squares experiments; no new ARC or human-prediction performance result.
Interpreting a chosen energy weight as an empirically calibrated likelihood without an additional observation model.

declarations.name: LinearInputBayes.posterior_compose
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem posterior_compose {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (w L M : α → ℝ)
    (h : mass (fun x => w x * L x) ≠ 0) :
    posterior (posterior w L) M = posterior w (fun x => L x * M x)

declarations.name: LinearInputBayes.posterior_commute

    posterior (posterior w L) M = posterior (posterior w M) L

theorem curve_weight_as_tilt {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (w : α → ℝ)
    (β : ℝ) (ε : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : α → ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    posterior w (fun x => Elastica.exponentialWeight β ε (θ x) ℓ) =
      tilt w (-β) (fun x => Elastica.energy ε (θ x) ℓ)

    pushWeight LinearInputF0.exampleK aliasPriorLeft = pushWeight LinearInputF0.exampleK aliasPriorRight ∧
